steps.step: MC1 three-family vertices on the pair labels: V1 (decoupled) invariant under Z4^3 x| S3 and A4-monomial, not under a rotated A4 or SO(3); V2 (all pairs) SO(3)-invariant but not per-family Z4; V3 (interfamily) A4-monomial-invariant, not per-family Z4
steps.detail: V1 decoupled: {'Z4^3 x| S3': True, 'A4 monomial': True, 'A4 rotated': False, 'SO(3)': False}; V2 SO(3) all pairs: {'Z4^3 x| S3': False, 'A4 monomial': True, 'A4 rotated': True, 'SO(3)': True}; V3 interfamily: {'Z4^3 x| S3': False, 'A4 monomial': True, 'A4 rotated': False, 'SO(3)': False}

steps.step: MC2 Z4^3 x| S3 admits exactly one Delta N = 4 family tensor, sum_f e_f^{x4}: V1 is the unique Delta N = 4 three-family structure of the decoupled symmetry

MC3 pair-label decomposition: A4-monomial diagonal pairs 1 + 1' + 1'', off-diagonal pairs 3; SO(3): S^2(3) = 1 + 5 (Casimir 0, 6); Z4^3 x| S3: the diagonal triple (O_11, O_22, O_33) is irreducible (character norm 1, no invariant)

MC4 required mediator: eliminating a degenerate multiplet coupled to the components of R gives Q = projector onto R; V1 needs one real Z4-odd Spin(10) vector per family (degenerate, unmixed): a (10, 3_signed-perm) of Z4^3 x| S3, = 1 + 1' + 1'' under A4; an A4-vector triplet (10, 3) produces V3 (interfamily), not V1

MC5 the v117 transport maps V1 to itself in the A4-monomial family basis but not in the original family-mode basis: the per-family basis of the three-family Gate-B vertex must be the A4-monomial basis

MC6 source link (representation level): [J(16,4) J(16,4)] in (10, S^2 4) contains S^2(3) = 1 + 1' + 1'' + 3 under A4, i.e. per-family composites Phi_{A,f} ~ [J^f J^f]_10 of the light families; the omitted-line singlet S^2(1) is not needed for V1 (bulk Z4 charge, gap, residue, coupling and SW residual still open)

MC7 (statement) SOURCE.MEDIATOR.COVARIANCE.01 = R_PHI_DETERMINED_FOR_V1: (10, 3_signed-perm) of Z4^3 x| S3, degenerate and unmixed, restricting to 1 + 1' + 1'' under the A4 transport group, in the A4-monomial family basis
